Groups into Single-Elimination |prizepool= |tournaments=4on4 |entrance= |website= |sdate=2000-01-21 |edate=2000-04-29 |twitch= |teamfirst=Flaming Fist |teamfirstflag=se |teamsecond=CAPSLOCK |teamsecondflag=se |teamthird=Euthanasia |teamthirdflag=se |teamthird2=Clan Malfunction |teamthird2flag=fi |map1=dm2 |map2=dm3 |map3=e1m2 }} == Introduction == * Round: Villains 2 - Group 1 * Match: {{Flag/de}} [[Imperial Bounty Hunterz]] vs {{Flag/ru}} [[End of Days]] * Date: 2000-02-13 == Match report == === DM2 === iBh: 425 - ED: 5
[[Image:Ed-ibh-dm2.jpg]]
Map pick by Imperial Bounty Hunterz.

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/d/de/Ibh-ed--dm2--123-20000213.qwz 1-2-3 (iBh)] | [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/9/92/Ibh-ed--dm2--flocutus-20000213.qwz Flocutus (iBh)] | [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/a/ac/Ibh-ed--dm2--slop-20000213.qwz sLoP (iBh)]

"The first frag in that game was done about 30 minutes later than it was planned because both teams weren't able to get a server which gave equal pings. Dm2 was played on a Danish server and iBh had a small ping advantage over ED who often lagged badly. iBh got the first quad with a quadladder done by sLoP. The Quad RL was taken by ED and he directly killed iBh's quaddude. I don't know who got other RL first but the game went very well for iBh right from the start so i think that they also got early control over the RL room too. After two minutes the map already was locked down by iBh without any chance for ED to find into this game. When the clock passed the 6th minute the score was already 100 - 2 to iBh and sometimes ED even had a negative frag count. There's not much to say about this game it just went on straight with kills by iBh. They've again shown their mad skillz on dm2 and won this game with incredible 425 - 5 which looks like a new Villains' record... (Ego's comment: Actually, no. In Villains season I, Euthanasia locked down Danish SYG on DM2 ... finishing on a nice and even 432 - 2)." -Andy === E1M2 === iBh: 197 - ED: 78
[[Image:Ed-ibh-e1m2.jpg]]
Map pick by End of Days.

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/d/d1/Ibh-ed--e1m2--123-20000213.qwz 1-2-3 (iBh)] | [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/7/7b/Ibh-ed--e1m2--flocutus-20000213.qwz Flocutus (iBh)] | [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/5/5b/Ibh-ed--e1m2--slop-20000213.qwz sLoP (iBh)]

"The server had to be changed again. I don't know where that server was but it seemed to be a bit better for ED's players. iBh's ISDNers went to ping 90-110 but their both T1/3 players still had nice 50 pings. iBh got a good start by getting the first Rl and Quad. The YA was under their control in a few minutes too and ED had to go back to MH and GA area. So did they, iBh controlling quad, gl, ya most time of the game and ED having the GA+MH area. A few YA attacks by ED were successfully done but iBh quickly got their locations back. ED did a lot better on that map but iBh just played too strong for them and finally took the game with 197 - 78." -Andy == Summary == * Score: 2-0 * Total frags ** iBh: 622 ** ED: 83 __NOTOC__ [[Category:Matchreports]]
